newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha slips, traders await November demand.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha slips, traders await November demand.

text.p: NWE naphtha edged lower as traders said they were waiting for demand next month from the petrochemical industry to lift the market.
Cargoes fell about $6 cif NWE to $220/$222 a tonne but traders said the physical market was very quiet.
Nov swaps fell $4.50 to $216/$217 and Dec lost about $3.50 to $211/$212.
"I'm not seeing much end-user demand in the Med or in northwest Europe," right now, said one trader.
